he.text: תָּבֹא לְפָנֶיךָ תְפִלָּתֵנוּ וְאַל תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתֵנוּ׃ תָּבֹא לְפָנֶיךָ תְפִלָּתֵנוּ אֶל־הֵיכַל קָדְשֶׁךָ׃ תָּבֹא לְפָנֶיךָ אֶנְקַת־אָסִיר כְּגֹדֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ הוֹתֵר בְּנֵי־תְמוּתָה׃ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בּוֹשְׁנוּ בְמַעֲשֵׂינוּ וְנִכְלַמְנוּ בַּעֲוֹנֵינוּ׃

en.text: May our prayer come before thee, and hide not thyself from our supplication. May our prayer come before thee unto thy holy temple. Let the sighing of the prisoner coming before thee, according to the greatness of thy power, preserve thou those that are appointed to die. Our Lord, we are ashamed of our deeds, and confounded by our iniquities.
